obtainable_fields: clip ID; URL; broadcaster/creator/video/game IDs; language; title; view_count; created_at; thumbnail; duration; VOD offset; featured
authentication: Client-ID and app or user access token
rate_limit: token-bucket headers; endpoint pagination; current limit documented by Twitch
historical_availability: clips remain queryable while available; time-window query is at most one week; VOD link/offset may be null
reproducibility: IDs, query parameters, UTC retrieval time, cursor, and raw response hash can be recorded
restrictions: no anonymous Helix access; deletions and changing counts; Twitch developer agreement applies
use_limitations: API content and branding/use remain subject to Twitch terms

obtainable_fields: video/stream/user IDs; title; description; created/published times; URL; thumbnail; view_count; language; type; duration
authentication: Client-ID and app or user access token
historical_availability: archives/highlights/uploads only while retained or published; ordinary VOD retention is limited by account/settings
reproducibility: stable IDs and raw-response hashes; later replay can differ after expiry/deletion
restrictions: no anonymous Helix access; view_count is mutable; no clip conversion attribution
use_limitations: Twitch developer agreement and content terms apply

obtainable_fields: live stream ID; user ID; game; title; tags; viewer_count; started_at; language; user metadata
authentication: Client-ID and app or user access token
historical_availability: streams endpoint is present-state only; users present-state
reproducibility: timestamped snapshots reproducible as observations but not replayable as the same state
restrictions: viewer count is a snapshot and audience is a confounder

obtainable_fields: video/channel IDs; publication time; duration; liveStreamingDetails; views; likes/comments when exposed; subscriber/video/view counts
authentication: API key for public data; OAuth for private/owner data
rate_limit: quota units; default project allocation commonly 10000 units/day; method costs differ
historical_availability: public videos while available; search is not a complete historical census; live details depend on broadcast state
reproducibility: record IDs, parts, request, retrieval time, response hash, and quota project context
restrictions: deleted/private videos disappear; subscriber counts may be rounded/hidden; no native Twitch-to-YouTube lineage
use_limitations: YouTube API Services Terms and developer policies apply

obtainable_fields: watch time; retention; traffic and audience dimensions subject to API/report support
authentication: OAuth and authorization from content owner/channel
reproducibility: good for consenting-channel study with saved report definitions
restrictions: not a public-data source; dimensions can be restricted or deprecated

obtainable_fields: authorized user's video IDs; creation time; title/description; duration; share/embed URLs; like/comment/share/view counts when approved fields are granted
authentication: developer app plus user authorization and approved scopes
historical_availability: authorized user's available videos; not a public census
reproducibility: record granted scopes, IDs, retrieval time, response hash
restrictions: user consent; app review/scopes; no native livestream-source lineage
